name: Renaud
source:
Leader of the Shisai Knight Troupe.
He was raised together with Teresa like siblings.
A boy with an angelic pureness.
He admires [url=/c43962]Levias[/url], who looks just like his older brother who died because of him, from the bottom of his heart.
He has a natural skill in magic and wishes to fight while leading the magician forces.
